Resolves #21854

The Picker focus fixture now sends its events through a dedicated window and releases that window during teardown. Teardown also releases the outside focus target.

Evidence: L2 (isolated same-worker reproduction and full focused suites) → L2 required (both acceptance criteria).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | On the hosted source the dispatcher test passed alone and failed after Picker with an extra `null` key. The same ordered pair passed with retries disabled after the fix. |
| AC-2 | Picker teardown calls `FocusManager.removeWindow` for its own event window. The following dispatcher assertion observes only `focus-origin`. |

## Deltas from ticket

The existing teardown also owns the outside focus target and releases the pending-window record directly through `removeWindow`.
